What happens if I file my Income Tax Return late?

Depending on your circumstances and applicable tax laws, delayed filing may result in late fees, interest, delays in refunds and restrictions on carrying forward certain losses.

Can I claim an Income Tax Refund after filing my ITR?

Yes. If excess TDS or advance tax has been paid and you are eligible, filing your Income Tax Return is the process through which you can claim your refund.

Why is carrying forward losses important?

Eligible business or capital losses can often be carried forward to future years, subject to the provisions of the Income-tax Act. Timely filing may be required to avail this benefit.

Who should file an Income Tax Return?

Income Tax Return filing may apply to salaried employees, freelancers, consultants, business owners, professionals, companies, LLPs and partnership firms depending on their income and applicable legal provisions.
